title: Diet Days Aligned with a Pet's Existing Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Subscription
content:
The diet days of a new prescription diet Autoship (an Autoship Pharmacy subscription under Tailwise Autoship for the pet's Rx Prescription Diet prescription) follow the pet's existing prescription Autoship. That Autoship's weeks between shipments are counted in days at 7 days a week. One full fill's days are the diet prescription's days' supply per fill; one bag lasts those days divided by the diet prescription's packages per fill.

## Rule

| Existing prescription Autoship of the pet | Further conditions | Diet days |
|---|---|---|
| In status active | Its latest charged shipment is no more than its weeks between shipments in days plus 21 days old, **and** those days plus 21 are fewer than one full fill's days | Its weeks between shipments in days plus 21 days |
| In status paused, payment hold or prescription hold | — | One full fill's days less the days one bag lasts |
| Any other case | — | One full fill's days, unchanged |

The age of the latest charged shipment is the calendar days from its charge date to the day the value is worked out.

## Worked cases (hypothetical: diet prescription of 90 days and 3 bags per fill, so one bag lasts 30 days)

| Existing Autoship | Weeks between shipments | Latest charge, days ago | Weeks in days plus 21 | Diet days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| active | 6 | 40 | 63, fewer than 90; 40 is within 63 | 63 |
| active | 6 | 64 | 63 | 90 (latest charge older than 63 days) |
| active | 10 | 20 | 91, not fewer than 90 | 90 |
| paused | 6 | — | — | 60 |
| payment hold | 4 | — | — | 60 |
| active | 6 | 63 | 63, fewer than 90; 63 is within 63 | 63 |
